---
applyTo: "**/*.cs"
---

### Creating Tests

RULES:

- Create a unit test (if appropriate) to ensure the user acceptance criteria is met
- Keep tests simple
- Test boundary conditions

### Running Tests

RULES:

- Run associated tests after making changes to code

### Fixing Tests

- Determine if failing tests are:
 - An expected result of code changes (broken tests)
 - Unintended consequences of the changes (broken code)
- Only fix broken tests
